## What changed

Describe the user problem and the change.

## How it was checked

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] Relevant tests (`pnpm test` when applicable)
- [ ] `pnpm build` when applicable
- [ ] Native platform checks, if this changes packaging or OS behavior

## Safety and documentation

- [ ] No credentials, real database data, or generated installers are included.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and limitations are documented.
- [ ] Platform support claims match the evidence in `docs/COMPATIBILITY.md`.
- [ ] Screenshots are attached for user-visible UI changes.
